recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait of two men in urban streetwear against a stark white background, framed by heavy, ultra-condensed black and red typography at the top and bottom edges.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject interaction through leaning and crouching poses
Primary red accents against a neutral white and black foundation
Extreme verticality in top typography versus wide tracking in bottom typography
Textural contrast between velvet/tracksuit fabrics and metallic gold jewelry
coreInvariants: Horizontal red rule line separating header text from imagery
Gold jewelry as a focal point of status

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical stack; one figure crouching low, the other standing and leaning over, occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The standing figure's red tracksuit and the bold black header text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: Header text leads to the standing figure, down to the crouching figure, and finally to the widely spaced footer text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: High volume of clean white space surrounding the central figures to emphasize their silhouettes.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Red (tracksuit, hat, and rule lines)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red elements against a high-value white background creates a punchy, graphic effect.

letterConstructionRules: Header: Extreme vertical elongation with minimal horizontal width
Footer: Wide tracking with square-proportioned characters
Uniform stroke weight within each line
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is rendered in a contrasting red color within the black header string

composition.relationshipToImage: separated by a red rule line
anchors the base of the composition

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Vertical tension versus horizontal expansion; black condensed vs red wide.
graphicDevices: Technical metadata text in small block sans-serif

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed, heavy vertical presence of the header.
Provides the geometric, clean structure needed for the wide-tracked footer.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of two men in 1980s hip-hop fashion (one in a red tracksuit and hat, one in a tan velvet tracksuit) posing against a seamless white background. Include visible gold chains and rings. Leave significant empty space at the top and bottom margins.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of ultra-condensed black uppercase text at the top, with a red ampersand. Place a thin red horizontal line below it. Add a single line of red geometric uppercase text at the very bottom with extreme character spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the bottom text widely spaced?
Is the ampersand red while the rest of the header is black?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the footer text
Thickness of the red rule line
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text overlaps the subjects' heads
Check that the red rule line is perfectly horizontal
Verify the white background is free of shadows or gradients
Confirm the gold jewelry has a metallic sheen
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + White Negative Space + Condensed Header + Wide Footer + Primary Red Accents
